method: One AI evaluator, script-assisted cognitive walkthrough; hypothetical perspectives, zero recruited participants

coverage.nativePhoneEvidence: Reused earlier 22 October emulator verification; source review for collapsed chat entry

audienceHypothesis: People already using coding-agent CLIs who want several projects organized and PC work continued from Android

findings.title: Make the first useful conversation explicit
findings.observation: Fresh setup has 14 agent choices and an unchecked optional launch action. Saving reaches an empty nine-panel grid. A plus opens the selected local shell.
findings.hypothesis: A user new to agent CLIs may need help understanding prerequisites and starting a conversation.
findings.recommendation: Explain the selected agent/account requirements and offer an explicit Open first console action with readable first-use text.
findings.validation: A real first-time user explains what will open and reaches a first prompt without assistance; test real provider login separately.
findings.evidenceConfidence: Directly reproduced UI behavior; user impact unvalidated

findings.title: Give existing folders a quick project path
findings.observation: Saving an existing folder automatically opens the planning brief. The project still has an Open console action. One-time console options use right-click.
findings.hypothesis: A CLI user bringing a working repository may find planning and hidden launch options an unnecessary detour.
findings.recommendation: Offer Open existing folder alongside Plan a new project, and a visible launch-options control.
findings.validation: Attach and open an existing folder without planning; separately verify deliberate planning and discoverability of launch options.
findings.evidenceConfidence: Directly reproduced UI behavior; user preference unvalidated

findings.title: Put a visible reply action on the phone console
findings.observation: Collapsed native chat entry is a thin gradient handle with a semantic Enter chat mode label and no visible word. Terminal keys is separately visible.
findings.hypothesis: A sighted new user may overlook normal message entry.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible Message or Reply label and preserve manual Terminal keys and target identity.
findings.validation: On a physical paired phone, ask someone to reply without describing the gesture; exercise a sample permission prompt and connection failure.
findings.evidenceConfidence: Current source and earlier emulator evidence; no new native session in this study

findings.title: Give every finished prompt a useful destination
findings.observation: Saved reports group under the console and preview. A synthetic completion without a saved artifact shows No results were saved for this prompt and leaves the previous report visible.
findings.hypothesis: A completion alert recipient expects an answer or a clear route to that prompt even when it produces only text.
findings.recommendation: Provide a readable outcome or pinned route to the corresponding answer while preserving exact chat/prompt attribution.
findings.validation: Find outcomes from older artifact and text-only prompts after later work completes; repeat after deletion.
findings.evidenceConfidence: Reproduced with a synthetic completion; no real AI answer or OS toast exercised

findings.title: Clarify account usage and optional API readiness
findings.observation: API totals lead Usage. Provider account data is unknown. API templates are listed with no keys saved. Existing estimate boundaries and local encryption labels are present.
findings.hypothesis: Users may confuse subscription usage with the optional API ledger or read a template as a ready connection.
findings.recommendation: Separate account usage and API spending, and show actual connection readiness with setup actions.
findings.validation: Ask a CLI account user which figures apply to their account and which actions make API requests.
findings.evidenceConfidence: Directly observed empty states; comprehension unvalidated

findings.title: Correct the shared drag handle ARIA
findings.observation: Axe reports aria-prohibited-attr, serious, on the generic .window-drag-handle div with aria-label. Repeated on three states in four profiles.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unsupported name or implement complete appropriate semantics and keyboard behavior; verify window controls manually.
findings.validation: Rerun the audit and keyboard flow; confirm zero instances of this shared violation.
findings.evidenceConfidence: Confirmed automated finding and source inspection; one unique shared defect

decision: Review the four priority-1 improvements as a bounded next batch; validate with real people before broad audience or demand claims. No implementation or milestone approval is recorded.
